statement: The residual Hecke summand belongs to the product block just specified. The exact projective-generator functor gives L = Homcts,G2 (P, M), 26 taken in the compact dual category of the specified product block, with the right Eloc-action by precomposition. It is faithful over T, finite over Rps loc, and finite over T. The local pseudodeformation action on L is the restriction of the global Galois action, with the stated cyclotomic twist. In particular, T is finite over Rps loc. At a coefficient point x : T → E′, after finite extension of E′, its Banach Hecke eigenspace contains d O v|2 Πv, where Πv is an irreducible unitary Banach representation with local parameter (rx|GFv ⊗ ε)ss, of determinant χvε2, in the block normalization of Section 2. If every local parameter is absolutely irreducible, de Rham, and regular, the eigenspace has a nonzero locally algebraic vector. If the untwisted parameter at v is γ1,v⊕γ2,v, with ratio outside {1, ε, ε−1}, the possibilities are the continuous unnormalized upper-Borel inductions Ind GL2(Q2) B (γi,vε ⊗ γj,v), {i, j} = {1, 2}.
